items: Local builder initially stopped because SOURCES={} also matched EXPECTED_SOURCES={}; replacement was anchored to a complete line and the builder plus scheduler control-flow review passed afterward.

Diagnostic source binding uses normalized text bytes exactly as originally embedded and written remotely; Windows CRLF file hashes are retained locally and are not substituted for remote LF source hashes.

Inspection found that the previous unexecuted final CPU wrapper still referenced the resume controller exit inside six embedded scripts. New external wrappers bind all six to the new actual completion source; old wrapper files remain intact.

Diagnostic headroom guard failure is preserved separately from production failures. A unique continuation reuses completed serial references and runs only the missing parallel phase; acceptance requires the actual continuation result and process exit.
